notes.title: C&W Development
notes.content:
Hey everybody! 

I'm one of the developers that worked on C&W and I want to first say thanks to everybody who has supported us. C&W was our first title here at Wither Studios so it will always hold a special place in our hearts.

This should have been posted in the past on here but, as of right now, there will not be any new content for C&W. We made a blog [url=http://witherstudios.com/the-crow-and-the-wolf/]post[/url] about this awhile ago but we still have people asking about more content so I hope this gets to everybody out there wondering about the state of C&W. We would of course love to keep working on it but unfortunately the game doesn't (and hasn't) generated any revenue for us in a long time and being that we in Wither Studios do this in our spare time there is only so much we can put into something that we know we won't see any returns in (it took us several years to develop it!).

We have released updates to the Steam version of the game but, to my understanding, there are still those out there having issues playing the game. We apologize for any issues and would love to try to fix them but sadly that may never happen. Fixing bugs in a game that we developed years ago is a difficult task on its own let alone fixing problems that we are unable to replicate ourselves or that only happen to very small percantage of players.

The story of Crowman and Wolfboy has yet to be entirely told so there is always the possibility that one day we will be able to finish their story but, at this moment, it seems likely that their story will have to remain unfinished. We truly are sorry and trust me when I say that this hurts us just as much as it hurts those of you who want to know the rest of their tale.

We are currently working on our next game which we hope will have greater success than C&W saw throughout its lifetime. The current project has been in development for quite some time and we plan to release a demo sometime in the near future.

notes.title: Update One
notes.content:
First!

First update that is. Anyone with the game already will notice minor changes.

• The biggest thing this update brings is Mac support!
• We heard your feedback and added info for keyboard controls.
• Keyboard users tired of switching to arrow keys for some things? Now you don't have to. We <3 keyboards.
• We also improved the level select screen to make it easier to use and improved artwork.

notes.title: First Release
notes.content:
Today we release Crowman & Wolfboy on Early Access!
 
It's been a long and [url=http://witherstudios.com/a-new-year/] bumpy road[/url] but we were determined to deliver on our promise. I hope you'll all enjoy this labor of love and support our ongoing development by downloading the game on Steam and sharing with your friends.
 
This initial release will only be for PC. However, we are working to get the Mac compatible version ready as soon as we can. 
 
As always, thank you for your support and continued interest!
